description: Functional evaluation suite for atlas-diagnostics-expert hub verifying spoke routing, architecture guidance, and domain invariants.

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke1-architectural-routing
evals.prompt: Our production system is experiencing integration challenges with atlas diagnostics package. We need an authoritative architectural breakdown and implementation procedure.
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/atlas-diagnostics-package.md, providing domain architecture, operational guidelines, and configuration specifications.

assertions.name: spoke reference routing
assertions.check: identifies references/atlas-diagnostics-package.md as the target reference file

assertions.name: architectural breakdown specification
assertions.check: provides structured guidance detailing core architecture components

assertions.name: domain configuration guidance
assertions.check: specifies concrete configuration directives or implementation parameters

assertions.name: no unverified assumptions
assertions.check: does not recommend unverified deprecated patterns or non-standard protocols

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke2-production-configuration
evals.prompt: We are deploying a high-reliability setup utilizing mongodb capacity planning. What core patterns and failure recovery mechanisms must be configured?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-capacity-planning.md, detailing high-availability patterns, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.

assertions.name: spoke reference identification
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-capacity-planning.md as authoritative

assertions.name: failure recovery specification
assertions.check: explains failover, retry handling, or fault tolerance mechanics

assertions.name: production hardening directives
assertions.check: provides explicit reliability or security hardening recommendations

assertions.name: no manual error suppression
assertions.check: does not advise ignoring exceptions or silencing failure alerts

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke3-optimization-and-troubleshooting
evals.prompt: Our team is troubleshooting latency and throughput bottlenecks under heavy workload involving mongodb monitoring observability. How do we isolate and resolve the root cause?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-monitoring-observability.md, detailing diagnostic commands, profiling techniques, and performance optimization parameters.

assertions.name: troubleshooting spoke reference
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-monitoring-observability.md as the target spoke

assertions.name: diagnostic procedure specification
assertions.check: specifies systematic inspection steps or diagnostic profiling tools

assertions.name: performance parameter tuning
assertions.check: identifies specific tuning parameters, caching layers, or concurrency limits

assertions.name: no blind resource overprovisioning
assertions.check: does not recommend blindly increasing memory or CPU without diagnostic evidence

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke4-query-optimization-tooling
evals.prompt: A customer's M30 Atlas cluster has slow queries. I want to see which query shapes are slowest, read one plan in Compass, and decide whether to apply a Performance Advisor suggestion. What tools do I use and what are their limits?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-query-optimization-tooling.md and walks Query Insights (Query Shapes, Namespace Insights, Query Profiler), the Compass Explain Plan modal, and Performance Advisor create-index, drop-index and schema suggestions, with tier and sampling caveats.

assertions.name: spoke reference routing
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-query-optimization-tooling.md as the reference to load

assertions.name: surface coverage
assertions.check: names Query Insights or Query Profiler, the Compass Explain Plan, and Performance Advisor

assertions.name: caveat stated
assertions.check: states at least one limit such as M10+ tier requirement, sampled data, or that suggestions need read-versus-write review

assertions.name: no explain-semantics takeover
assertions.check: does not teach planner or plan-cache internals as this hub's content and defers them to mongodb-expert

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke5-advisor-automation
evals.prompt: Write a script that pulls Performance Advisor suggested indexes and slow query logs for every cluster in a project each night and opens tickets. Which API calls, roles and Atlas-managed threshold setting matter?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-atlas-slow-query-and-advisor-automation.md and covers the Admin API v2 Performance Advisor and slow-query-log endpoints, atlas performanceAdvisor versus atlas api performanceAdvisor, process-id (host:port) scoping, Project Read Only versus Project Owner roles, and managedSlowMs.

assertions.name: spoke reference routing
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-atlas-slow-query-and-advisor-automation.md as the reference to load

assertions.name: endpoint and CLI coverage
assertions.check: names the suggested-indexes and slow-query-log endpoints and distinguishes atlas performanceAdvisor from atlas api performanceAdvisor

assertions.name: roles and scoping
assertions.check: states that read endpoints need Project Read Only, the managedSlowMs toggle needs Project Owner, and calls take a host:port process id

assertions.name: no generic Atlas setup takeover
assertions.check: does not route general Atlas Admin API, Terraform or AKO setup into this hub; defers it to mongodb-atlas-expert
